item.title: BNB Chain details new layer-1 for trading, private finance and AI
item.description: The proposed network will operate alongside BNB Smart Chain and retain BNB as its native token, with a public testnet targeted for the first quarter of 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Binance completes withdrawal recovery four weeks after $6.3B hack
item.description: The announcement concludes a phased withdrawal recovery that began on Nov. 1, when Binance restored Bitcoin withdrawals following the record crypto theft.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: UK is ‘getting it wrong’ on DeFi regulation, says Coinbase
item.description: Coinbase and Stand With Crypto argue that the FCA’s proposed DeFi rules could leave UK users without regulated access to decentralized finance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
item.description: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Spain moves to grant financial watchdog power to freeze crypto accounts
item.description: A new decree would allow Spain’s financial intelligence unit to suspend crypto accounts, with firms facing fines for noncompliance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Crypto on notice as hawkish Fed risks December ‘meltdown’
item.description: Economist Robin Brooks warned of dire consequences for stocks if the Federal Reserve fails to deliver dovish cues before the FOMC blackout period.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
item.description: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: How EU brokers could lose access to Kyrgyz crypto exchanges
item.description: A vote on Kyrgyzstan could make an exchange’s home country the deciding factor in whether a European broker can use it to settle a trade.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
item.description: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: 7 bizarre things crypto whales spent a fortune on
item.description: The crypto rich have spent their fortunes on everything from dinosaur skeletons to rotting fruit, with some purchases defying belief.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Vitalik Buterin calls for verifiable chips as hardware wallet threats evolve
item.description: Buterin warned that future attacks could use lookalike chips with hidden malicious functions, making hardware tampering harder to detect.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody suffers data breach
item.description: Zodia Custody’s CEO said the breach exposed names and email addresses of some clients and employees and was detected by the company Monday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin price eyes $61K as Talos warns of thin Thanksgiving liquidity
item.description: Bitcoin joined US stock futures in a modest relief rally as Talos questioned crypto demand and the broader outlook for the AI trade.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
item.description: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
item.description: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
item.description: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: UK regulator plans tighter DeFi rules, citing $6.3B Binance hack: Report
item.description: North Korea-linked hackers used DeFi protocols to launder stolen Binance funds, while US prosecutors moved to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
item.description: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: 1Password hacker stole customer names and emails, but vaults safe
item.description: The password manager, which is used by millions of people to store their login credentials, said customer vaults were unaffected by the breach.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
item.description: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: AI labs likely sitting on cryptography ‘bombshells,’ computer scientist says
item.description: AI is driving a massive wave of mathematical breakthroughs which could have implications for cryptography.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Switzerland clears 57 jurisdictions for crypto tax data sharing
item.description: The move paves the way for Switzerland to exchange crypto tax data with foreign authorities starting in 2028 as part of a global effort to combat tax evasion.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
item.description: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
item.description: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats
item.description: Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook

item.title: Bitcoin falls toward $57K amid US tariff fears, hot PCE data as Nasdaq drops 4%
item.description: The prospect of higher US tariffs and hotter-than-expected PCE inflation weighed on Bitcoin, crypto and stocks on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
item.description: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
item.description: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
